records.scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Irrigated Agriculture Modernisation Project (TNIAMP)
records.description: TNIAMP is a multi-disciplinary project funded by World Bank and implemented by the Government of Tamil Nadu. The main objective of the programme is to accelerate crop diversification from crops requiring more water to high remunerative and less water requiring Horticultural crops, through promotion of hi-tech cultivation technologies. Tamil Nadu irrigated Agriculture Modernization Project is being implemented from 2018-19 to 2024-25 in 66 sub basins covering 34 districts (except Kanyakumari, Tiruppur, Nilgiris and Chennai) In crop Demonstration component the emphasis will be given to diversification of Horticulture crops like Vegetables, Fruits, Flowers, Spices and Plantation Crops. Also encouraging Pandal Cultivation, Mulching, Shade net erection, Integrated Pest Management and Micro irrigation technologies with 100% subsidy to small and marginal farmers and 75% to other farmers. In the year 2022-23, the scheme is being implemented in 54 Sub-Basins. Model village concept is being implemented in Phase I (Third year) 16 districts comprising 61 villages and Phase II (First year) 12 districts comprising 34 villages.
records.eligibility: All districts (except Kanyakumari, Tiruppur, Nilgiris and Chennai) Preference will be given to small and marginal farmers, women farmers and SC / ST farmers.
records.documents: 1.Chitta 2.Adangal 3.Passport size photo - 2 Nos 4.Photocopy of Ration Card/ Smart Card 5.Photocopy of Aadhar Card 6.Bank account Details

records.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee yojana (PMKSY) - Micro Irrigation(MI)
records.description: "Micro-irrigation technology is an effective technology that increases the water use efficiency by 40 to 60 percent by using water resources judiciously. This technology also increases the fertilizer use efficiency, reduces the wastage of fertilizers, controls weed growth and reduces labor cost significantly. By adopting micro-irrigation technology, the cultivated area can be greatly increased. In Tamil Nadu, the Micro Irrigation Scheme is implemented from 2007-08 onwards. Micro Irrigation is being implemented through an online portal உயடடநன “Micro Irrigation Management and Information System-MIMIS”. 100 percent subsidy is being provided for small/marginal farmers up to 2 hectares and 75 percent subsidy is being provided for other farmers up to 5 hectares.12% GST applicable on Micro Irrigation System is also absorbed by the Tamil Nadu Government for the benefit of the farmers. 65 firms have been registered through TANHODA for the implementation of this scheme. During the year 2022-23, this scheme has been proposed to be implemented in an area of 1,15,000 Ha at an outlay of Rs.960 Crore covering Horticultural and Agricultural crops."
records.eligibility: "All districts except Chennai Preference will be given to small and marginal farmers, women farmers and SC / ST farmers."
records.documents: "1.Chitta 2.Adangal 3.Passport size photo - 2 Nos 4.Photo Copy of Ration Card/ Smart Card 5.Photo copy of Aadhar Card 6.FMB 7.Soil/Water Test Report 8. Bank account details 9.Small / Marginal Farmer Certificate"
